deals.evidence: Steve Cohen closed his record $2.4 billion deal to purchase the team from Sterling Equities
deals.headline: Steve Cohen closes record $2.4bn purchase of the Mets
deals.summary: Cohen, who already owned 8%, bought control from Sterling Equities in a deal described as $2.4bn-plus (per sources), then a North American team record; Sterling kept 5% of the club and SNY. MLB owners and NYC approved on October 30, 2020.

attendance.evidence: They finished the 2025 season at No. 5 with 39,775 fans on average.

ownership_summary: Steve Cohen (founder of Point72 Asset Management), who already held 8%, bought control of the Mets from the Wilpon and Katz families' Sterling Equities in a deal closed in November 2020 for a record $2.4bn-plus; Sterling retained a 5% stake and SNY. Steve and Alexandra Cohen are listed as owners.
